name: @cas/monodromy
description: Monodromy of the roots (or sheets) of a family over a loop: finite permutation groups (compose, cycles, generated group, commutators, derived series, Sₙ/Aₙ recognition), π₁ generator loops (lassos, winding numbers), the plotter's nearest-match continuation (≈, never certified) and the CERTIFIED root tracker (Smith discs in exact arithmetic, bisection, refusal by name). Extracted from the Complex Function Plotter's src/riemann/ when Polynomial Root Analysis became its second consumer (ADR-0007, ADR-0047). Consumed via SOURCE by the suite's Vite/Vitest bundlers (no dist build).
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
